name: Orang Pendek
description: A small, ground-dwelling, bipedal primate reported from the mountainous rainforests of Sumatra, Indonesia, particularly Kerinci Seblat National Park, described as 80–150 cm tall with dark fur and considered one of the more credible cryptid primate reports due to consistent descriptions and physical evidence.

aliases.name: Sedapa
aliases.meaning: Regional name used in Dutch colonial-era accounts

aliases.name: Hantu Pendek
aliases.meaning: Short ghost — Suku Anak Dalam (Orang Rimba) term, framing the creature as supernatural rather than biological

origin: Remote mountainous forests of Sumatra, Indonesia, with sightings concentrated in the Kerinci Regency of central Sumatra, particularly within Kerinci Seblat National Park (TNKS). Historical reports suggest the creature's range may extend more broadly across Sumatra.
